name: tygazen-js
description: The one game-integration surface for the TYGA game center (tygazen.com) on the web: native signup, the pixel face builder, and clip-moment telemetry. One tygazen, one face, every game.
// sideEffects: NOT false. avatar/options.js exists FOR its side effect — it publishes the config->options mapping on globalThis.PixelOptions, which pixel-editor.js reads at module scope. With sideEffects:false a bundler is free to drop `import './avatar/options.js'` entirely, and esbuild says so out loud: "Ignoring this import because dist/avatar/options.js was marked as having no side effects". Every bundled consumer therefore had no global and a dead editor. Naming the one file that has side effects keeps the tree-shaking everywhere else.

scripts.build: node scripts/build.cjs && npm run build:browser && npm run build:types
